notes: The correction is confined to *come out of him*: rule 106's scope clause hands the particle to the expressed preposition, so ἐξ takes *out of* headed on *out* and ἔξελθε keeps a bare *come*.
Everything else stands: the article before Ἰησοῦς is `unrepresented` under rule 23, and Φιμώθητι takes the whole idiom *Hold thy peace* headed on the meaning-bearing complement.
